description: Audited employer override: force ONE SCHEDULED (gated, not yet actionable) assignment OPEN now, with a required reason recorded as an ACTIVATION_OVERRIDDEN event. One-way: the worker is notified, due/blocking schedules start from this instant, and a provider-owned item (e.g. the Hubstaff setup to-do) triggers its DEFERRED provider invite/enrollment now. Converges with alreadyActive=true if rule evaluation won the race. Requires project_todos:write.
name: opentrain_activate_project_todo
